processing.sharingAnswer: Apply Google's service-provider and user-initiated/prominent-consent exceptions only after checking the actual provider terms and configuration. No advertising or data-sale integration is included in this app.
processing.retention: Saved receipts and originals are retained; they are not ephemeral. Deletion can leave necessary security/usage records and backup copies for the disclosed retention period. Original uploads may contain embedded metadata.
